name: soko-mcp
description: MCP server for Africa commodity price intelligence and market signals
author: Gabriel Mahia

tools.name: commodity_price_query
tools.description: Indicative price of a commodity in a Kenyan market (nairobi, nakuru, eldoret, kisumu or mombasa). Use when a farmer or trader asks what something sells for. Prices come from a SYNTHETIC demo dataset, not market observations. An unknown commodity or market returns status NOT_FOUND with the markets that have data, never a guess. Returns status, the price details and a note to verify at eagc.org or a county market board. Read-only.

tools.name: regional_price_comparison
tools.description: Compare a commodity's indicative price across Kenyan markets relative to the farmer's location. Use when someone asks where to sell for the best price. Based on SYNTHETIC demo data; an unknown commodity returns NOT_FOUND. Returns status and the regional comparison. Transport costs and quality are not modelled: verify prices before travelling. Read-only.

tools.name: price_trend_analysis
tools.description: Seasonal price trend (rising, falling or stable) for a commodity in a market over the next 1 to 6 months. Use when someone asks whether prices are likely to go up or down. This is a simple seasonal model on SYNTHETIC data, not a forecast: real prices depend on weather, exports, policy and currency. An unknown commodity or market returns NOT_FOUND. Returns the trend, its driver, a warning and the source. Read-only.

tools.name: sell_hold_decision
tools.description: Compare selling now with storing a commodity for up to several months, using seasonal averages, the quantity, storage cost per month and months you can store. Use when a farmer asks whether to sell or hold. A DEMO model on SYNTHETIC seasonal averages: not advice, and real decisions need actual prices, storage quality and buyer contracts. An unknown commodity or market returns NOT_FOUND. Returns the current value, a recommendation with rationale, the future price scenarios and where to verify prices. Read-only.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Indicative prices for several commodities in one market, with a seasonal context note. Use when someone wants a snapshot of a market. commodities is a comma-separated list such as maize,beans,potatoes; any not in the dataset are listed in commodities_not_found. Returns status, market, date, season context, the prices and the not-found list. Prices are SYNTHETIC demo data: verify at eagc.org or county market boards. Read-only.
